hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate the same single-variable sandwich kernel K(a,b,x) twice, with (a,b,x)=(V,G0,p) and (W,H0,q), then sum the two results.
required_assumptions: Function multiplication is well-defined for the substituted functions at the indicated variables.
hypotheses.rationale: The two summands are syntactically identical up to a uniform renaming of the outer function, inner function, and variable; both are instances of one sandwich form a(x)b(x)a(x).
